title: Vivid BAD SQUAD Chapter1 Episode18 Len, MEIKO, and the Reserve Member

meta.Episode: Episode18 — Len, MEIKO, and the Reserve Member

rows.Line: Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Here's your coffee and cheesecake.
Would you like milk and sugar?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Pass. I mean... No, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'll have a coffee too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You need milk and sugar, right? Here you go.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmph. I may need it now, but eventually I'll be able to drink it without any. Stop treating me like a kid, will you?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Those two sure are lively.
Is it a little too awkward to chat now?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, Akito. Did you and Toya have a fight?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well... Not exactly.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Apparently, he just never thought of us as a unit.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hm? I don't really know what happened, but you sure look sad, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I have a friend who's really important to me, too.
We're always together, and it's so much fun when we sing, but...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We still fight sometimes, so I kind of understand.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It always feels really lonely after you fight with someone close to you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I just don't get it...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: How am I supposed to take it when he suddenly tells me our music has no meaning?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: With him, even surpassing RAD WEEKEND is possible...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: He must really be important to you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hey, I have something reserved for just such an occasion. Care to try it?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What is it?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Here you go! Drink that, and you'll feel right as rain♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Um... MEIKO, isn't that a whiskey glass?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: This definitely doesn't look like something you should be serving to a minor.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Don't worry about it! Just toss it back!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toss it... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
This smells like oolong tea.
Why go to the trouble of making it look fancy with ice and a nice glass?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Are you trying to fool me or something?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
It's strange, don't you think?
Even the things right in front of us aren't always exactly what they seem.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? What's that supposed to mean?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Perhaps what your friend said isn't the way he truly feels.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya isn't the joking type, so I just assumed he meant exactly what he said...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But if he wasn't being honest with himself...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Damn it, I need to...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? A call from Ken?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hello, this is Akito.
Is something wrong? It's not like you to call me.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya is at the restaurant?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'll be right there! Would you stay on the line?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Akito, good luck!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Right. Oh...and, um...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thanks all for the help.
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Sorry for the wait, Toya. Here's your usual blend.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, but Ken... Today, I...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
You came to say goodbye, yeah?
This one's on me. Consider it a thank you for all the times you've come in before.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Maybe we should step out for a bit, Kohane.
It looks like he's got something important to talk about.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: B-But, he said he came to say goodbye. Does that mean...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Would you stay?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You two are part of the reason I was finally able to come to a decision.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And besides, I'd feel bad leaving with Azusawa still worried about me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Aoyagi...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Just promise you won't tell Akito.
I don't want him to be disappointed in me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um, okay.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ken, you've probably already heard from Akito, but I decided to quit singing as a member of BAD DOGS.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Though for me and my music, BAD DOGS was everything. So, that's why today will be my last time coming here.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: ...I see.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
We'll miss you around here.
And one less person for Akito to complain to means my job'll get that much harder.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: My apologies...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Heh. I'm just kidding.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ken, please take care of Akito for me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He's really serious about surpassing you and RAD WEEKEND. He has a tough road ahead of him though and there's plenty of competition...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I know I don't really have any right to ask this of you, though.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Don't worry. You can count on me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Akito can be pretty stubborn, eh?
Nothing can break him. But that's what makes him so interesting.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: In that regard, though, I think you two are a lot alike.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm afraid you're wrong...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I'm not like Akito.
The only reason I'm here is because I was running away...
